steps.message: Click the Line button to start drawing the contour of the swipe section.
Finish drawing the contour in the ground.
Use a right-to-left selection window to select the segments.
rotate the selected segments around the x axis (red)  to bring them vertically, use a T helper placed at the rotation center.
Use a left-to-right selection window to select all the created segments.
Click the Walk button, you can switch cameras mid-command
Click the Orbit button to switch back to orbit camera.
draw an arch shape ( line L, 2 x C - 2 quarter circles and L the end segment parallel to the first ). Press Enter to finish
Use a left-to-right selection window to select al the geometry.
Rotate the selection around the line passing through the threshold of the arch and rotate it to the vertical.
